universities.summary: PSG College of Technology is an autonomous college at Peelamedu, Coimbatore, established in 1951 and affiliated to Anna University. These listings cover 43 regular degree routes:35 preserved engineering, computer-application and management offerings plus eight science degrees, including bachelor’s, graduate-entry mathematics and five-year integrated computing or fashion study. universities.campusLifestyle: The college shares its historic Peelamedu campus with the PSG Industrial Institute, reflecting its long-standing connection between academic study and industrial practice. faq.question: Which PSG institution is this?
faq.answer: This is PSG College of Technology at Peelamedu, Coimbatore, affiliated to Anna University. Its TNEA code is 2006. PSG College of Arts & Science, PSG Institute of Technology and Applied Research and PSG Polytechnic have separate admissions.

faq.question: How long is engineering study?
faq.answer: The listed regular BE/BTech degrees follow a four-year structure. Mechanical Engineering Sandwich is a five-year self-financing route with morning practical training and evening classes. Do not apply the four-year format to that route.

faq.question: What subjects are required for undergraduate engineering?
faq.answer: The verified academic school route requires recognised HSC/Class 11 and 12 study with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. TNEA sets 45% general and 40% for the specified Tamil Nadu reservation categories. Separate vocational and equivalence routes need their own assessment.

faq.question: Who can use the FN/OCI route?
faq.answer: The college explicitly lists 16 regular four-year engineering programmes for foreign-national/OCIadmission. Applicants need 12 years of schooling, 45% PCM average, English medium or English as a school subject, and the scheme documents. Selection remains provisional pending the relevant authorities.

faq.question: Do those overseas approvals cover every course?
faq.answer: No. The 2026–27 approval table distinguishes regular undergraduate engineering from Mechanical Sandwich and postgraduate courses. This page restricts the latter to verified domestic routes; a general overseas-admission statement does not establish every programme’s availability.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The preserved engineering, computer-application and management records retain their verified English information. A teaching-language policy is not assigned to the eight new science entries; confirm the exact department’s arrangements.

faq.question: When did first-year cohorts join?
faq.answer: The verified undergraduate engineering orientation baseline is 17 August 2026. Separate dated 2025 ME/MTech, MCA and MBA cohort information remains on the preserved records. These dates do not establish a first-entry month for the eight science additions or announce a future intake.

faq.question: How do postgraduate qualifications differ?
faq.answer: Each engineering master’s has an exact accepted-degree and branch list. MCA has separate degree, Mathematics, marks and education-pattern conditions. The PSGIM institutional MBA route requires 60% in a recognised bachelor’s degree, while MBA Waste Management and Social Entrepreneurship requires 55%.

faq.question: Are tuition amounts confirmed?
faq.answer: Request an itemised quote for the exact degree, admission category and funding choice. General fee categories do not establish programme-specific annual tuition or the FN/OCI schedule. Separate university charges, deposits, practical training and hostel/mess costs before budgeting.

faq.question: Which science degrees are included?
faq.answer: The additions are BSc Applied Science, BSc Computer Systems and Design, MSc Applied Mathematics, and five-year integrated MSc Software Systems, Theoretical Computer Science, Data Science, Cyber Security and Fashion Design and Merchandising. Other PSGinstitutions and awards with unresolved approval are separate.

faq.question: How do science applicants enter and get selected?
faq.answer: Bachelor’s and integrated routes require their named 10+2 subjects; Applied Mathematics requires a named qualifying degree. The computing integrated group has a campus Mathematics test and counselling, while other science routes use academic shortlisting and counselling. A call does not guarantee admission.

faq.question: Are the entrance examination languages the teaching languages?
faq.answer: No. The 2026 computing integrated test offers English and Tamil question papers. That does not establish degree teaching language. Instruction language and first-entry month remain unspecified for the newly added science routes; confirm with the department.

faq.question: What do the new programme fee figures cover?
faq.answer: They are indicative, unitemised amounts for the named course. Confirm current charges and the applicant/funding category with the college. Separate tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation and examination costs may need an itemised quotation; no whole-course budget is guaranteed.
